name: Ring of Force Block
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of force shield. Instead of creating a controllable shield like wall of force it creates a randomly moving invisible obstacle in the area of the wearer. Anyone, including the wearer, who attempts to make an attack into, out of or through any 5 foot square adjacent to the wearer has a 10% chance of striking the obstacle instead of the intended target.

Anyone other than the wearer who attempts to enter, exit or move through any 5 foot square adjacent to the wearer has a 10% chance of colliding with the object which halts their movement within that square.

Anyone who remains in any 5 foot square adjacent to the wearer has a 10% chance per round of being forced out of the square by the obstacle. This would be treated as a bull rush attempt, with the obstacle having a CMB of +10.

Casting remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, though the enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of force shield

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
